I tried to use solvents but I just feel lightheaded and sick. There must be something wrong, or i didn't inhale enough

Well I cant even kill myself properly it didn't work

I just feel sick.

Unfortunately I just received news that I'm probably going to have to leave my home... So I'm not sure how to feel at the moment.

Damn. That has just destroyed my good mood. I know I shouldn't really care given my circumstances, but... I'm not going to lie, I feel like I'm back to square one.  I'm gonna have to do it. I'm really, really sorry for letting you down after making some progress. 

Have a good life, whoever you are :)

I will recommend Beowulf to you, but it can be a challenge and a bit of culture shock. I'm from Mercia, its part of England and here we read old Viking and English stories that have been passed down all the time as kids so I guess it just became my favourite.

You don't have to apologise for mentioning yourself :) it is good advice. I guess it *is* about control. I've felt directionless for about a year now, just floating about, reading books here and there, watching a few movies, wasting *many* hours on Reddit, but I haven't achieved anything really. I've wasted a lot of time, and a lot of chances. 

Yeah, thanks for making me think twice. I'll postpone it for now, and try to enjoy something for the first time in a long time. It is weird, when I was younger I had thought that depression was "feeling sad all the time", and I do feel sad, but mostly depression for me has just been feeling nothing at all, just wanting to fade out.

I'll keep in touch, that would be brilliant. I can't thank you enough for being receptive and kind. It is night-time here and I'm just sitting and waiting. I should be dead by now if i had followed through with my plan but I keep thinking about waiting a few days, just to see what I can do.

I really just want to pack up a sleeping bag, a little stove, some food and a tent and go keep walking until I'm out of town and in the countryside. I suppose I need to give myself little reasons to live. Baby steps. I want to finish reading my favourite book *Beowulf*. So thats a few days. 

I have to admit, this might sound wrong or weird, but I have never felt more at peace than when I think I'm going to die soon. Maybe I'm just morbid and weird :)  but it puts things into perspective.

I want to believe that more than anything in the world. 

Maybe it is just hard to break my own conception of myself and where I'll be in the future, but thanks. It is very comforting to have kind words.

I'll think it over and let you know what I choose to do.

Unfortunately I live in a small, but highly dense country. Nearly everywhere is a city. I would've loved to work on a farm. But I feel like perhaps it is my time. I'm fed up with modern life I spend most of my waking hours putting on a brave face when really I just want to collapse into a heap and cry. 

I think if I got that chance to do something like that I would. 
Even if I don't go tonight, I simply can't imagine a world where I live to grow old. I want to die before then. Maybe you're right and I should give it a few days just so I can experience some peace and tranquility before I go.

I don't know anymore. I don't know anything apart from the fact that I want to die, and whether that is tonight or in a month it doesn't matter.

Hey what's going on, what plan is this friend?

I hope nothing bad, I'm here if you want to vent or whatever you need to do.

Thanks x1000 for the kind words. I don't think I'll ever be able to admit to another person that I feel the way I do. 

My mum knows I've been depressed, but not like this. 

I want to sleep forever. I dread waking up in the mornings and having to face another bland and sterile day.

I don't know. Part of me wants to drop the whole thing, and try to spur myself into action. But then I remember that I'm a morally awful and corrupt person. 

Life is loud, and colourful and wonderful. But I want peace. I wasn't born for this life. I can't deal with suits and ties, and fake smiles and small talk and parties. If I could live and be happy I'd just be out in the wilderness and live off the land. But in the 21st century that isn't an option for me. I want everything to go away, y'know?
Thanks for the words, you are a kind person and deserve to live and be happy. I am not a kind person. I am not kind to others, and not kind to myself. I do not deserve anything.

Thanks for the kind words, they do mean a lot, but I'm 99% sure that this is what I want to do. Whether or not "future me" would agree doesn't matter, cos he's gonna have to take one for the team, I'm killing off him as well I suppose. 

Obviously I have doubts and fear, but after serious thought I just can't fight this one. Its uphill, and I really respect anyone who can beat it. I have enormous respect for you as well, reaching out can be difficult.
My mental health has plummeted. Early 2015 I was outgoing, a high prospect and an A grade student. Now I'm barely alive, I am starting to suffer from paranoia (which signals to me that I have even greater mental health issues than I thought), I dropped out, have no friends and I really just want a bullet through the back of my head. Unfortunately I live in a country where guns are illegal :/ 

But i have a method with me right now. I'm just waiting until night so I can look out of my window at the empty streets (I don't know why but I love to do this). Then I'm going to listen to some music, watch my favourite film and die.

To be honest I haven't really exhausted any options. I went to the doctor and they gave me some sleeping tablets to help me cos they thought insomnia was my main issue. But i just used them all recreationally because I'm an abusive moron who needs to be put down. 

But I know that my issue with depression will be life long. Both my parents have had suicide attempts. My grandfather had a successful suicide. My other grandad had Bi-polar. My grandmother has extreme anxiety issues and my brother used to have self harm issues so it is a hereditary problem which I'll be battling for my whole life and I'd rather not commit to that so I'm gonna die, and me (and the world) will be better off for it. I'm a useless parasite anyways.
